_comment: Stryker's vitest runner, patched in patches/@stryker-mutator__vitest-runner@10.0.0.patch: Vitest 5 joins suite and test names with ' > ' and the runner joined them with a space, so its testNamePattern matched nothing and every mutant survived. inPlace because tsconfig.json extends ../../tsconfig.base.json, which a sandbox copy cannot reach. tsconfigFile points at a file that does not exist on purpose: Stryker would read tsconfig.json through the TypeScript JavaScript API, which TypeScript 7 no longer ships; Vitest resolves TypeScript on its own.
